note: Overrides the core Views 'text' area plugin class with RoleBasedGlobalText (via hook_views_plugins_area_alter), adding a Roles fieldset (roles checkboxes + negate) to any Global: Text area. Options stored in the display's area handler under roles_fieldset.roles and roles_fieldset.negate. Empty roles = show to everyone; roles+no negate = only those roles; roles+negate = everyone except those roles. No config schema/permissions/Drush. Medium/hard read and write these options on a real view (vrbgt_role_view / vrbgt_task_view).

evals.prompt: Using views_role_based_global_text, how do I show a Views 'Global: Text area' (e.g. a header) only to certain user roles, and what happens if I select no roles?
evals.expected_output: The module adds a Roles fieldset to the Global: Text area settings; check the roles that should see it. If no role is selected the text is shown to everyone (default behaviour).

evals.prompt: What does the 'Negate' option do on a Global: Text area provided by views_role_based_global_text?
evals.expected_output: With roles selected and Negate on, the text is shown to everyone EXCEPT users with the selected roles (instead of only to those roles).

evals.prompt: Where are the role settings for a views_role_based_global_text Global: Text area stored, and what handler class implements the behaviour?
evals.expected_output: They are stored in the view's area handler options under roles_fieldset.roles and roles_fieldset.negate; the class RoleBasedGlobalText (extending core's Text area handler) implements it, swapped in via hook_views_plugins_area_alter().

evals.prompt: On this site the View 'vrbgt_role_view' has a header Global: Text area with role-based visibility configured. Inspect the view configuration: which role is selected and is the selection negated (i.e. who actually sees the text)?
evals.expected_output: The header text area selects the 'anonymous' role with negate = TRUE, so the text is shown to everyone EXCEPT anonymous users (i.e. only logged-in users). Read views.view.vrbgt_role_view display.default.display_options.header.area_text.roles_fieldset.

evals.prompt: The View 'vrbgt_task_view' has a header Global: Text area that is currently shown to everyone. Using views_role_based_global_text, restrict it so only users with the 'authenticated' role see it, and save the change to the live view.
evals.expected_output: Set the header area's roles_fieldset.roles to include 'authenticated' (authenticated => authenticated) with negate FALSE and save the view. verify checks roles_fieldset.roles['authenticated'] is truthy on vrbgt_task_view.
